action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Dawid Golunski discovered that CakePHP incorrectly trusted the CLIENT-IP
HTTP header when determining the client IP address. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to spoof their IP address.
isummary: CakePHP could be made to trust a spoofed client IP address.

title: CakePHP vulnerability
